metadata.note: 1981 US CB900F: four-stroke inline four, evenly spaced events in the service manual's 1-2-4-3 firing order (p25-4). Stock 4-into-2 with two tailpipes; collector pairing, balance link and all tube dimensions are acoustic estimates. Valve equivalent area assumes two 23 mm exhaust valves (diameter unverified for this market); open fraction uses 93 BBDC + 180 + 70 ATDC at zero lift, p25-3, not the one-mm timing. Silencer bodies are approximated by straight pipes, not measured recordings. See docs/road-bikes.md.
